# Five Budget Evening Meals for Two (Under £40)

## Meal 1: Spaghetti Bolognese
**Cooking time:** 25 minutes

**Ingredients:**
- 500g minced beef
- 250g spaghetti
- 1 tin chopped tomatoes (400g)
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Olive oil, salt, pepper, dried herbs

**Method:** Brown beef with onion and garlic; add tinned tomatoes and herbs; simmer 15 minutes. Cook pasta separately; combine.

---

## Meal 2: Chicken Stir-fry with Rice
**Cooking time:** 20 minutes

**Ingredients:**
- 400g chicken breasts, sliced
- 250g long-grain rice
- 1 red pepper, sliced
- 1 yellow pepper, sliced
- 150g broccoli florets
- 2 carrots, julienned
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 2cm piece fresh ginger, grated
- 150ml soy sauce
- Olive oil, salt, pepper

**Method:** Cook rice. Stir-fry chicken, vegetables, garlic and ginger in oil; add soy sauce; toss with rice.

---

## Meal 3: Bean Chilli with Rice
**Cooking time:** 20 minutes

**Ingredients:**
- 2 tins kidney beans (400g each)
- 1 tin chopped tomatoes (400g)
- 2 onions, diced
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 150g rice
- 1 tsp chilli powder
- 1 tsp cumin
- Olive oil, salt, pepper

**Method:** Sauté onions and garlic; add spices; tip in beans and tomatoes; simmer 10 minutes. Serve over rice.

---

## Meal 4: Jacket Potatoes with Tuna Salad
**Cooking time:** 45 minutes (mostly oven time)

**Ingredients:**
- 4 large potatoes
- 2 tins tuna (160g each)
- Mixed salad leaves
- 1 cucumber, chopped
- 3 tomatoes, chopped
- Butter, salt, pepper

**Method:** Bake potatoes at 200°C for 40 minutes. Flake tuna and mix with chopped salad vegetables. Split potatoes, add butter, top with tuna mixture and salad.

---

## Meal 5: Vegetable Soup with Crusty Bread
**Cooking time:** 30 minutes

**Ingredients:**
- 3 medium potatoes, diced
- 3 carrots, diced
- 2 celery stalks, diced
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 vegetable stock cubes
- 1 crusty baguette
- Olive oil, salt, pepper

**Method:** Sauté onion, celery, carrots; add potatoes and stock; simmer 20 minutes until tender. Serve with warm bread.

---

## Combined Shopping List (Organised by Supermarket Aisle)

### **FRESH PRODUCE**
- Onions (3)
- Carrots (5)
- Potatoes (8 medium/large)
- Red pepper (1)
- Yellow pepper (1)
- Broccoli florets (150g)
- Celery (1 bunch)
- Garlic (1 bulb)
- Fresh ginger (small piece)
- Tomatoes (3)
- Cucumber (1)
- Mixed salad leaves (1 bag)

### **MEAT & POULTRY**
- Minced beef (500g)
- Chicken breasts (400g)

### **FISH & TINNED GOODS**
- Tinned tuna (2 tins, 160g each)
- Tinned kidney beans (2 tins, 400g each)
- Tinned chopped tomatoes (2 tins, 400g each)

### **DRIED GOODS & GRAINS**
- Spaghetti (250g)
- Rice, long-grain (500g bag)

### **CONDIMENTS**
- Soy sauce (150ml)
- Olive oil (if needed)

### **DAIRY & BAKERY**
- Butter (250g)
- Crusty bread/baguette (1)

### **HERBS & SPICES**
- Dried herbs (Italian seasoning or oregano)
- Chilli powder
- Cumin
- Vegetable stock cubes (2)
- Salt & black pepper

**Estimated Total Cost:** £20–£25

This leaves you well under budget and means you could add extras like cheese, wine, or puddings!
